office: the Ministry of the Interior, Directorate General of Population and Family

routes.label: at the Directorate General of Population and Family (not abroad)

note: The IRB's 2016 response: the digital identity card (introduced by the 2014 reform) is issued by the Ministry of the Interior's Population Branch to citizens of 18 and over, and (the 2017 response adds) cannot be applied for or obtained outside Djibouti; the Director of Population and Family told La Nation (2014) that applicants pay DJF 2,000 in procedural fees and that the card is valid ten years. No later fee was found; the time isn't stated.
